provenance.caution: Historical chronological experiments must not be directly compared with the participant-disjoint grouped protocol.

data.same_day_features: Only measured before target-report timestamp; other sensor data are lagged/past-only.
data.cold_start_definition: Number of prior labeled fatigue observations, not calendar days.
data.train_test_rule: Do not change sealed split or read test outcomes during development.

primary.name: grouped_7x12_2
primary.pooled_scoring: Aggregate only out-of-fold predictions on all development people; do not average unweighted fold metrics for model selection.

secondary.name: LOPO_14
secondary.reporting: Supplementary robustness and participant-level heterogeneity; no hyperparameter or threshold tuning based on LOPO results.

bootstrap.method: resample participants with replacement, keeping each sampled participant's entire set of out-of-fold predictions; duplicates retained as resampled clusters
bootstrap.invalid_auc_draws: Exclude AUC/AP draws without both classes, report invalid and valid draw counts and any unavailable CI.

report: sample counts per participant and period
mean and standard deviation across people when defined
analysis_common.leakage_policy: All imputers, scalers and estimators fit on training participants only. Personal history for validation participants is derived exclusively from their own earlier labels (shift=1); this represents an online-follow-up scenario, NOT fully label-free cold start.

experiments.goal: Describe existing models as personal labeled history accumulates; no hyperparameter updates.
experiments.implementation_note: Existing validation_metrics.json stores only aggregate metrics, not individual out-of-fold predictions. Re-run development folds with stored OOF predictions as required; no access to sealed test.

experiments.goal: Compare incremental feature families under the same participant split.
experiments.feature_definitions_rule: Before running, write exact disjoint feature-column mapping for every group and verify selected model pipelines actually consume the mapped columns. No data-driven post-hoc remapping.

adoption_rule.comparison_to_group_A: Also report each model/feature group's incremental effect versus its own group-A version.
adoption_rule.tie_or_uncertain: Prefer simpler feature group/model; describe confidence interval without treating 9/14 as a significance test.

experiments.goal: Explore discrimination of high-fatigue days; do not claim safety from model alone.

metric_definitions.ROC_AUC: pooled development out-of-fold risk probabilities/scores; report as undefined when either class absent
metric_definitions.within_person_AUC: Compute ROC-AUC for each participant with >=3 positive AND >=3 negative validation days; average participant ROC-AUC equally; report eligible and ineligible IDs/counts.
metric_definitions.recall_at_10pct: Rank all 7-fold development out-of-fold days by risk, descending, choose exactly ceil(0.10*N) days using deterministic participant/date ascending tie-break; detected positives divided by all positive days.
metric_definitions.precision_at_10pct: True positives divided by selected warning days.
metric_definitions.false_positive_rate_at_10pct: Selected negative days divided by all negative days.

baseline_references.random_average_precision: Observed prevalence in validation set (reference approximately 113/1512=0.0747); report exact observed prevalence.

experiments.candidate_scope: Freeze classification algorithms, feature sets and hyperparameters in the experiment implementation before running; do not iterate on sealed test outcomes.
experiments.decision_rule: Targets are exploratory research benchmarks, not a clinical guarantee. Report failure plainly. Keep regression and high-fatigue risk objectives separate; no combined score.

model_selection.regression: Choose according to pooled 7-fold MAE and preregistered E2 adoption rule; keep personal median as fallback.
model_selection.high_fatigue: Report the E3 binary risk task separately; require all preregistered success targets for a positive exploratory claim, but do not promote to a safety controller.
model_selection.no_unlimited_followup_search: The planned experimental family is limited to E1–E3; additional tuning requires a separately versioned protocol.

safety_and_rl.safety_layer: Separate deterministic safety filter for user-reported current/most-recent fatigue, sleep deficit, injuries and high recent training load; design and scenario-test rules independently.
safety_and_rl.prediction_role: Supplementary uncertain signal, never sole safety gate.
safety_and_rl.RL_scope: Gymnasium simulation and Q-Learning/DQN are future stages, not implemented in this experiment.
